# Integrate Health

> Integrate Health is an AI medical scribe built specifically for functional, integrative, and holistic medicine practices. It captures full patient visits (including 30+ minute, in-depth appointments), generates structured SOAP notes in seconds, and syncs notes to the practice's EHR in one click. It is HIPAA compliant and signs a Business Associate Agreement (BAA).

Integrate Health is made by Integrate Health, LLC. Unlike general-purpose scribes, it is designed for longer, more detailed visits and understands functional-medicine content such as supplement protocols, lab interpretation, full patient histories, and care plans.

## Key facts
- Category: AI medical scribe / clinical documentation software
- Built for: functional, integrative, and holistic medicine practitioners
- Integrate Essential: $79/month, 1 provider, for light use
- Founders rate (first 100 clinics only): Integrate Pro at $79/month for the first 12 months, then $129/month
- Integrate Pro: $129/month, 1 provider, unlimited AI documentation, EHR sync, priority support
- Integrate Practice: $399/month, up to 4 providers, practice templates, admin and team tools
- Automate: custom AI agents for intake, scheduling, follow-ups, and billing, priced by quote
- Compliance: HIPAA compliant, BAA available, data encrypted in transit and at rest
- Workflow: speak (visit is captured) → summarize (structured SOAP note) → sync (one click to the EHR)
